incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429/503 rate for /v1/embeddings (hosted) detected. 5m spike -> 18% 429s, 4% 503s. Top affected tenant: tenant-42. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/traffic/429-503?panelId=3
Alex M.: Oncall here — seeing the same. Is traffic shaping already enabled for tenant-42?
Priya K.: Not for that tenant; they are on burst mode with no strict per-tenant caps.
Jin L.: I'm attaching quick PromQL we're watching:```sum by(status) (increase(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m]))``` results show status=429 jump.
Mateo R.: Initial customer impact from triage: several enterprise customers see degraded embedding latency leading to downstream retry storms in ingestion workers. Support ticket count +12.
Alex M.: Plan proposal: 1) enable circuit-breaker on embeddings endpoint for tenant-42 at 10r/s 2) apply temporary tenant quota of 300 req/min 3) route non-critical background jobs to fallback-quantized model 4) enable prefix KV cache for common prompts. Anyone object?
Clara P.: Product concern: we shouldn't drop foreground interactive requests for paid enterprise plans. Can we limit background jobs first?
Priya K.: Agreed — do background-only shaping first. I can push a quota-only rule scoped to tag=background. Command: ```rbctl policies apply --scope tenant:tenant-42 --patch '{"limits":{"background_requests_per_min":300}}'```
Alex M.: I'll do routing change for background jobs:```trafficctl route add --from embeddings.background --to embeddings.quantized.v2 --weight 100 --tenant tenant-42```
Jin L.: While that's rolling, I'm going to enable a more aggressive connection-queue timeout to reduce head-of-line blocking:```kubectl patch svc embeddings-svc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"sessionTimeoutSeconds":10}}'``` keep an eye on 503s.
incident-bot: Note: Automatic fallback activated for model r2-embedding -> r1-quantized when latency > 1.2s.
support-bot: Posting affected customer list: CUST-17, CUST-22, CUST-42 (tenant-42), CUST-99. Escalation to CSM scheduled in 15m.
Mateo R.: I'm seeing 429% drop after routing change — from 18% -> 9% in 3m. 503s unchanged.
Alex M.: Good. Next step: increase worker concurrency limit for quantized routing pool to absorb background load. Command:```scale pool embeddings-quantized --replicas 8``` Doing now.
Priya K.: Canary config applied. Also adding temporary global rate-limit per-IP to reduce noisy clients:```ratelimitctl set --route /v1/embeddings --per_ip 40/m --duration 10m```
Jin L.: Watchlist Prometheus queries: ```rate(http_requests_total{job="ingress",status=~"5.."}[1m])``` and ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings",status="429"}[5m])) by (tenant)```
Alex M.: I'm going to hand off active mitigation to Priya for overnight. Key points in handoff: current mitigations in place (background quota, routing to quantized, connection timeout, per-ip rate limits), residual 429s ~6%, 503s ~3%, support ticket surge +8. Handoff log:```Handoff: 1809998910 - Alex M. -> Priya K. Mitigations applied, watch for customer-affecting foreground drop.``` @Priya K. please ACK and add any follow-ups.
Priya K.: ACK. I'll hold primary page and will escalate to infra if 503s > 5% for 10m. Also will coordinate with CSM for enterprise customers.
Clara P.: Please mark prioritized customer CUST-42 for postmortem and include representative request traces.
Mateo R.: Collecting traces now:```es query --index traces "tenant:tenant-42 AND route:/v1/embeddings" --last 30m``` CCing SRE team for trace retention.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket if <resolved> not set in 2h.
Priya K.: Preemptive note for follow-ups: 1) evaluate default background cap policy 2) add tenant-specific burst limit in console 3) revisit fallback model throughput profiling. I'll update internal runbook with the exact commands used.
Alex M.: Thanks team. Leaving a quick snippet for runbook:```Mitigation quick steps:
- apply background quota
- route background -> quantized
- set per-ip rate limit
- monitor 429/503 via 5m panels and /alerts/429_spike```
Priya K.: Taking over; will post periodic updates every 15m. :white_check_mark:
